import pandas as pd
trips = tables['trips']
pier = tables['pier']

# season 2, doy 61-91, weekly yt rate by class
t2 = trips[(trips.fish_date_season==2) & (trips.fish_date_doy>=61) & (trips.fish_date_doy<=91)]
wk = t2.groupby([t2.fish_date_doy//7, 'cls']).agg(yt=('yt','sum'), anglers=('anglers','sum'), n=('yt','size')).reset_index()
wk['rate'] = wk.yt/wk.anglers
print("season2 doy61-91 by week/class:")
print(wk.to_string())

overall = t2.groupby('cls').agg(yt=('yt','sum'), anglers=('anglers','sum'), n=('yt','size'))
overall['rate']=overall.yt/overall.anglers
print("\nseason2 doy61-91 overall by class:")
print(overall.to_string())

# pier temp trend last 20 days
p2 = pier[(pier.ts_season==2) & (pier.ts_doy>=70)].groupby('ts_doy').wtmp_c.mean()
print("\npier temp C by doy (70-91):")

# season1 same doy range for comparison
